notes.title: Game free
notes.content:
1. The game is officially changed to the free mode. After logging in to the game, paid players will get a powerful prop - an infinite bullet revolver for free. If you support free players, you can buy clothes and props in the store to support me. Thank you.

2. The game interface is fully in English.
